run.question:
Look at the elasticsearch index 'app-278-events-n8c3v6q1': list which
fields it has (with their types), and using the index's actual field
names tell me how many documents in it are ERROR level.

report.summary: Index app-278-events-n8c3v6q1 exists (green, open, 27 documents) and maps exactly four fields: app (keyword), lvl (keyword), ts (date) and txt (text). Counting with the index's real field name lvl shows 9 ERROR-level documents. Across the whole authorized window the index holds 27 documents with lvl values INFO (12), ERROR (9) and WARN (6), so ERROR is 9 of 27. A sample of three ERROR documents shows app billing-278 and txt 'payment gateway timeout <n>'. Note the search tool always applies a time filter on the mapped date field ts, which cannot be disabled, so all counts are within the queried window.
